name: deploy-fastlane
description: fastlane lanes and a GitHub Actions workflow that build a Flutter app and upload it to TestFlight / the App Store and Google Play, with certificates from fastlane match and an App Store Connect API key.

APP_DIR.help: Flutter project directory relative to the repo root

next: Android signing: add the key.properties block from the deploy-flutter-fastlane skill (references/android-signing.md) to {{APP_DIR}}/android/app/build.gradle.kts.
Create the upload keystore once: keytool -genkey -v -keystore upload-keystore.jks -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -alias upload (keep it out of git; back it up in a password manager).
Create a private git repo for match certificates, then from {{APP_DIR}}/ios run: bundle install && bundle exec fastlane certificates
Upload the first Android build to Google Play by hand (Play Console requires it before the API can upload).
Set the repository secrets listed by: npx kashi secrets
